gloss: compact car; small car; subcompact vehicle

definitions.gloss: compact car; small car; subcompact vehicle

examples.japanese: {小型車|こがたしゃ}は{燃費|ねんぴ}がいい。
examples.english: Compact cars have good fuel economy.

examples.japanese: {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}が{狭|せま}いので{小型車|こがたしゃ}にした。
examples.english: I chose a compact car because the parking space is small.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{道|みち}が{狭|せま}いため、{小型車|こがたしゃ}の{人気|にんき}が{高|たか}く、{販売台数|はんばいだいすう}の{大半|たいはん}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: In Japan, because roads are narrow, compact cars are popular and account for the majority of vehicle sales.

notes:
Refers to small passenger vehicles, generally with an engine displacement of 660cc to 2000cc. In Japan's vehicle classification system, {小型車|こがたしゃ} occupies the middle category between {軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ} (kei cars, 660cc and under) and {普通車|ふつうしゃ} (standard/full-size cars).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}を{運転|うんてん}する: to drive a compact car
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}{専用|せんよう}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: compact car-only parking
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}{免許|めんきょ}: license for small vehicles
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}クラス: compact car class (for rentals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}: kei car (even smaller; 660cc max engine; yellow license plate in Japan)
- {普通車|ふつうしゃ}: standard car (larger; white license plate)
- コンパクトカー: compact car (loanword; used in marketing and casual speech)
- {大型車|おおがたしゃ}: large vehicle (trucks, buses)
